xhtml:span.xhtml:p:
Goal type for this term?
quantitative | qualitative | hybrid

xhtml:div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

xhtml:span.xhtml:p:
Enter quantitative fields
data_id, operator, threshold
aggregation optional

xhtml:div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

xhtml:span.xhtml:p:
Enter criterion text
human-readable description
of the condition

xhtml:div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

xhtml:span.xhtml:p:
Set timing
deadline YYYY-MM-DD
expiry YYYY-MM-DD
must be: expiry > deadline
grace_days: days after expiry
before timelock matures

xhtml:div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

xhtml:span.xhtml:p:
Aggregation across terms
AND: all terms must be met
OR: any term must be met

xhtml:div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

xhtml:span.xhtml:p:
Set collateral
currency: XMR | ZEC | BTC | ETH
amount per file
number of files in series
redemption_value optional

xhtml:div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

xhtml:span.xhtml:p:
Configure oracle panel
for each oracle:
pubkey hex 32-byte
role: quantitative | qualitative | both
fee per attestation

xhtml:div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

xhtml:span.xhtml:p:
Set quorum and challenge
minimum signatures to settle
challenge period in days

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

xhtml:span.xhtml:p:

total collateral locked
oracle panel summary
